mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(bsp.period_end_balance,0) startBalance from book_subject_period bsp LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bsp.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%') and bsp.year_period = #{currentPeriod} and bs.is_quantity = 1 and bs.is_leaf = 1

SELECT *,IFNULL(ROUND(periodDebit/quantityPeriodDebit,2),0) pricePeriodDebit, IFNULL(ROUND(periodCredit/quantityPeriodCredit,2),0) pricePeriodCredit from ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) periodDebit, IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) periodCredit, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='DEBIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) quantityPeriodDebit, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='CREDIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) quantityPeriodCredit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%') and bv.year_period >= #{startPeriod} and bv.year_period <= #{endPeriod} and bvr.price is not null and bvr.quantity is not null ) a

SELECT *,IFNULL(ROUND(yearDebit/quantityYearDebit,2),0) priceYearDebit, IFNULL(ROUND(yearCredit/quantityYearCredit,2),0) priceYearCredit from ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) yearDebit, IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) yearCredit, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='DEBIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) quantityYearDebit, IFNULL(SUM(IF(bvr.balance_direction='CREDIT',bvr.quantity,0)),0) quantityYearCredit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%')
and bv.year_period <= #{endPeriod} and YEAR(year_period) = YEAR(#{endPeriod})
and bvr.price is not null and bvr.quantity is not null ) a
